WEATHER TODAY: Cradock heat wave from midday, Upington peaks at 39°C
Weather for Thursday: Rustenburg, Potchefstroom and Klerksdorp reach 32°C under mostly clear skies, with Pretoria and Cape Town both at 29°C and no rain in Gauteng.
A hot, dry and mostly clear Thursday for most of the country, with Springbok at 35°C, De Aar at 34°C and extremely high veld fire danger over Kamiesberg and Matzikama. The only rain chance is in KwaZulu-Natal, where Richards Bay and Newcastle have a 30% chance of slight rain.
